name: ESO 199-G007 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 199-G007, a dwarf spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso199007-hubble
story: A small spiral galaxy in our wider cosmic neighborhood, ESO 199-G007 was one of the nearby galaxies Hubble surveyed, reading the brightness of its red giant stars to help map the local universe in three dimensions.

claims.text: ESO 199-G007 (HIPASS J0258-49) is a dwarf spiral galaxy
ESO 199-G007 is a Local Volume galaxy
The program measured distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of red giant branch stars, to build 3D maps of galaxies
